page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number top right; one list of entries (numbers 2 to 16, with page numbers at right) in the upper block; centred division heading "III. OECONOMICI." below; one list of entries (1 to 13, with page numbers at right) under it; one marginal note at right beside the first entry of the second list; gathering signature at the foot.
page.notes: The figures at the far left edge of the scan belong to the neighbouring page or show-through and are not transcribed. The Greek word in entry 8 is uncertain (the scan is small and the letters are partly blurred), so it is marked [?]. The number "Ira principis" line is the continuation of the list from the previous page; its entry number 1 is not on this page. The division heading "OECONOMICI." is set in letter-spaced capitals and is transcribed as one word. The page number and running head are printed in the top bar.
